## Why

What is wrong, missing, or costly today? Link the issue if there is one.

## Scope

One concern per pull request. Say what this change is responsible for and what it
deliberately leaves alone, e.g. "only the CI jobs — no engine code, no docs".

## What changed

Behaviour, not file list. Call out anything a reviewer would not infer from the diff.

## Verification

Commands you ran and their actual output. "Should work" is not verification.

## Known gaps

What you deliberately did not do, and why.
